title: WeGR: Unified Generative Retrieval for Industrial Search Systems in WeChat
abstract: arXiv:2610.16979v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) offers a promising paradigm for industrial search by unifying candidate generation within an autoregressive framework. However, its effectiveness is limited by two key challenges. First, existing Semantic ID (SID) tokenizers struggle to incorporate collaborative signals while maintaining effective codebook utilization, limiting their ability to distinguish items and achieve high-quality retrieval. Second, existing reinforcement learning (RL) methods suffer from severe reward sparsity under exact SID matching, leaving many sampled trajectories without effective learning signals and hindering preference optimization. To address these challenges, we propose WeGR, a unified generative retrieval framework consisting of two complementary components. Specifically, the Collaborative and Collapse-free Tokenizer (CoCo-VAE) incorporates query-to-item and item-to-item collaborative signals while mitigating codebook collap

translated_title: WeGR：微信工业搜索系统的统一生成式检索
translated_abstract: 生成式检索（GR）通过在自回归框架内统一候选生成过程，为工业搜索提供了一种有前景的范式。然而，其有效性受到两个关键挑战的限制。首先，现有的语义ID（SID）分词器难以在融入协同信号的同时保持有效的码本利用率，限制了其区分物品和实现高质量检索的能力。其次，现有的强化学习（RL）方法在精确SID匹配下存在严重的奖励稀疏问题，导致许多采样轨迹缺乏有效的学习信号，阻碍了偏好优化。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了WeGR，一个由两个互补组件构成的统一生成式检索框架。具体而言，协同无坍缩分词器在缓解码本坍缩的同时，融入了查询到物品和物品到物品的协同信号……
tldr: WeGR提出统一生成式检索框架，通过融合协同信号且避免码本坍缩的CoCo-VAE分词器，并解决强化学习中精确SID匹配带来的奖励稀疏问题，显著提升工业搜索的检索质量。
en_tdlr: WeGR is a unified generative retrieval framework for WeChat's industrial search that introduces CoCo-VAE, a collaborative and collapse-free SID tokenizer, and overcomes reward sparsity in RL-based preference optimization under exact SID matching.
